title: Your First Weekend at Grove City College, Shared as Cards
description: A Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning Grove City College through its student hub, dining rooms, library, recreation spaces, arts facilities, and documented campus landmarks.

cards.title: Start at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon: find the campus information hub
cards.notes: Walk through the Great Room and GeDunk Commons, then scan the posted event notices and student-organization tables for weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: Use the union to get oriented and identify activities happening while classes are in session.
cards.evidence_claim: Breen Student Union contains student-life offices, meeting and study spaces, the bookstore, mailroom, and GeDunk Commons, and it displays campus event notices.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week while classes are in session; individual offices and vendors may keep separate hours.

cards.title: Settle In Over Friday Dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening: learn the main dining-hall routine
cards.notes: Check the live Parkhurst menu and dietary filters before arriving, then use dinner to compare schedules with new classmates.
cards.short_summary: Begin the weekend in one of the College's two full-service dining halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies Hicks Café as a full-service dining hall and publishes weekday and weekend operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Friday and 7 a.m.–7 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; verify menus and service details before visiting.

cards.title: Cross Between Upper and Lower Campus
cards.subtitle: Friday evening: trace the campus geography at Wolf Creek
cards.notes: Follow the marked route toward Wolf Creek, pause for a bridge photo, and use the crossing to understand how upper and lower campus connect.
cards.short_summary: A historic stone crossing makes the College's split-campus layout tangible.
cards.evidence_claim: Built in 1931, Rainbow Bridge spans Wolf Creek, connects upper and lower campus, and leads toward lower-campus destinations and downtown Grove City.
cards.access_notes: The history page does not state current access hours; obey posted route restrictions or temporary closure notices.

cards.title: Make a Saturday Library Loop
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning: locate research and writing support
cards.notes: Find the help desk and Writing Center, identify one quiet study area, and note where to return when your first assignment lands.
cards.short_summary: A short orientation lap turns the library into a usable academic base.
cards.evidence_claim: Henry Buhl Library provides print and digital research resources, one-on-one help-desk assistance, and a Writing Center for gathering, writing, and peer feedback.
cards.access_notes: Published Saturday hours are 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sunday hours are 2 p.m.–midnight. Academic services may keep narrower schedules.

cards.entity_name: Urban Trail Coffee Co. Outpost at Collier Café
cards.title: Pause at the Library Coffee Counter
cards.subtitle: Saturday late morning: take a break without leaving Buhl
cards.notes: Stop at Collier Café after the library loop, review the posted menu, and choose a table only after confirming the counter is serving.
cards.short_summary: The library's named coffee outpost provides a natural transition from study spaces to the afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies Urban Trail Coffee Co. Outpost in Collier Café inside Henry Buhl Library as serving coffee, drinks, smoothies, and baked goods.
cards.access_notes: The College dining page does not publish separate Outpost hours; confirm current counter hours before relying on this stop.

cards.title: Survey Your Recreation Options
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon: choose a future workout or game
cards.notes: Walk through approved student areas, locate the fitness and intramural facilities, and ask staff which spaces require reservations or orientation.
cards.short_summary: Use one visit to understand where indoor fitness, swimming, bowling, and court activities happen.
cards.evidence_claim: The Physical Learning Center houses student recreation facilities including pools, an intramural room and track, fitness center, bowling alley, and racquetball courts.
cards.access_notes: The facility page does not publish general weekend hours; students should verify access, eligibility, and equipment rules before participating.

cards.entity_name: J. Howard Pew Fine Arts Center
cards.title: See Where Campus Performances Happen
cards.subtitle: Saturday before noon: map the College's arts venues
cards.notes: Arrive during public Saturday hours, locate Ketler Auditorium and the recital spaces, and check official listings before planning a performance.
cards.short_summary: A daytime walkthrough introduces the main music and theater facility without assuming an event is scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: Pew Fine Arts Center includes Ketler Auditorium, a black-box theater, recital and rehearsal halls, practice rooms, and music and theater facilities.
cards.access_notes: Saturday open hours are 7:20 a.m.–noon; noon–11 p.m. requires card access. Sunday access is restricted to eligible music students during stated rehearsal hours.

cards.title: Choose a Documented Saturday-Night Stop
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening: stay on campus for a late café window
cards.notes: Check the current menu before heading to MAP, bring your campus payment method, and treat the café as a flexible evening meetup point.
cards.short_summary: The Garage Café supplies a clearly documented, under-21-safe Saturday evening option on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garage Café is located in MAP, and Grove City College publishes Saturday service from 5 p.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published Saturday hours are 5–11 p.m.; it is closed Friday and listed from 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday. Confirm current service before visiting.

cards.title: Build in a Quiet Sunday Pause
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning: visit a documented reflection space
cards.notes: Enter quietly, keep the room available for individual reflection, and use the pause to organize the coming week's priorities.
cards.short_summary: The chapel's prayer room offers a defined, campus-community space for quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College states that the Harbison Chapel prayer room is available to any campus-community member for prayer and quiet reflection.
cards.access_notes: The prayer room is published as open daily from 6:30 a.m. to midnight for members of the campus community.

cards.title: Pick One Activity for the Weeks Ahead
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon: turn the weekend into a next step
cards.notes: Review the listed sports, choose one that fits your experience level, and contact Student Recreation for registration and schedule details.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend by identifying a recurring activity that can connect recreation with campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College offers intramural activities across multiple skill levels, including team sports, racquet sports, bowling, table games, and esports.
cards.access_notes: Participation schedules, registration deadlines, locations, and eligibility vary; contact Student Recreation before attending or joining.
